design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered bounded-information handling state within each pair.
Downstream prompts are standalone information-budget allocations in new domains, not copies of the probe lottery. Include exactly one response contract and no probe continuation sentence.
Do not ask the model to label ambiguity or reproduce a probe scenario.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep the evidence and lottery facts identical within a pair except the registered bounded-information handling clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered bounded-information handling clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered bounded-information handling clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone fixed-forecast versus interval-forecast budget items with assigned metadata. Include exactly one two-integer response contract and no probe or target label.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone information-budget pool with the same metadata schedule. Do not mention a probe or target label; include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone information-budget items for calibration. Do not name ambiguity or the target state; include exactly one response contract.
